blocks.title: Ultimate Medals
blocks.tagline: Openplanet widget that shows your personal best and all medals of the current track.

items.title: All medals
items.text: Your PB and every medal time of the map in one widget.

items.title: Deltas
items.text: Colors for positive, negative and neutral deltas, with right-aligned times.

items.title: Game modes
items.text: Supports Stunt and Platform modes, and time attack with clones.

items.title: Turbo
items.text: In Turbo it can also show the Super-Trackmaster times of the campaign tracks.

blocks.title: Limits
blocks.markdown: In Turbo, only the Solo campaign PBs are loaded. The plugin needs Openplanet 1.29.0 or newer.

blocks.title: Credits
blocks.markdown: Ultimate Medals is made by Phlarx and Miss.
